commands.name: New-OfficeWord
commands.synopsis: Creates a Word document from the theme, optionally running a content block that saves and closes it.
commands.notes: Keeping a document open means leaving out the block: the Live set returns the live WordDocument, and -Path is optional there (Save-OfficeWord -Path later). With a block -Path is required. With -Content saves and closes when the block ends and returns the file only with -PassThru; if the block throws nothing is saved and the partial file is removed. -NoSave is removed. -Template clones an existing .docx as starting content; -Theme applies a visual theme (built-in name, OfficeTheme or a .dotx/.docx whose theme is read). Refuses to replace an existing file without -Force. Password is valid only with a content block; apply save policy through Save-OfficeWord when working with a live document. Theme reads the source palette and Latin fonts; Template copies the document content.

examples.description: Creates Hello.docx with the default Modern theme and saves it when the block ends.

Add-OfficeWordHeading -Document $doc -Text 'Server inventory'
Get-Service -Name 'W32Time', 'Spooler', 'WinRM' |
    Select-Object -Property Name, Status, StartType |
    Add-OfficeWordTable -Document $doc
Save-OfficeWord -Document $doc -Path .\Reports\Server-Inventory.docx
Close-OfficeWord -Document $doc

commands.name: Open-OfficeWord
commands.synopsis: Opens an existing Word document, optionally running a content block that saves and closes it.
commands.notes: Replaces Get-OfficeWord. With -Content the document is saved and closed at the end of the block (not with -ReadOnly); without it the live document is returned. Opening never restyles the document. Saving at block end fails if content would be lost unless -AllowLoss.

commands.notes: -PassThru returns the saved file (FileInfo), not the document. A native save keeps today's strictness: it fails if content would be lost unless -AllowLoss.

Spacing, indentation and pagination of the current paragraph are set with Set-OfficeWordParagraph inside the block. -Alignment takes the shared OfficeAlignment (Left, Center, Right, Justify, Start, End), as on every text command.

commands.name: Add-OfficeWordPageNumber
commands.synopsis: Adds the current page number, optionally 'of' the total, inline in a header or footer.
commands.notes: -IncludeTotalPages becomes -IncludeTotal. The command writes only fields and the separator, never a label: the PAGE field gives "3"; with -IncludeTotal it writes PAGE, the -Separator text (default ' of ') and NUMPAGES, giving "3 of 12". Alone directly in WordHeader/WordFooter (no paragraph open) it adds one new paragraph holding just those fields, aligned per the theme. After WordText or inside a WordParagraph it appends the fields to that same paragraph, so WordFooter { WordText 'Page '; WordPageNumber -IncludeTotal } writes "Page 3 of 12" on one line. -Format takes WordFieldFormat (for example UpperRoman for "III"); -Format and -Separator exist in the source but were not exposed as parameters; they become real parameters.

commands.name: Set-OfficeWordParagraph
commands.synopsis: Changes style, alignment, spacing, indentation and pagination of an existing or the current paragraph.
commands.notes: Was Set-OfficeWordParagraphStyle. bool? parameters become switches; -KeepWithNext:$false turns a setting off. Without -Paragraph it formats the current DSL paragraph, so it works inside WordParagraph blocks without an alias.

Get-OfficeWordParagraph -Document $doc -Pattern '^Note:' |
    Set-OfficeWordParagraph -IndentationBefore 1cm -SpacingBefore 6pt -SpacingAfter 6pt
Close-OfficeWord -Document $doc -Save

GoogleDocsExportMode: Export, Plan, Batch. Plan returns GoogleDocsTranslationPlan, Batch the GoogleDocsBatch requests, Export the created GoogleDocumentReference. Without -Path or -Document it reads the document of the enclosing New-/Open-OfficeWord block, so the Document set is the default.

GoogleDocsInlineImageMode: Placeholder (default), TemporaryPublicDriveLease. GoogleDocsCommentMode: Skip, UnanchoredDriveComments (default). GoogleDocsTabStrategy: FirstTab (default), SelectedTab, ReplaceEveryTab. GoogleDocsRevisionConflictMode: RequireRevision (default), MergeAgainstTargetRevision, OverwriteLatest.
